title: What to track in a portfolio blog after launch
excerpt: A lightweight checklist for understanding which posts and sections actually get attention.
content:
## Watch entry and exit points

It is useful to know which article started the session, but also which section likely caused the reader to stop. That gives more signal than view count alone.

## Keep the list small

The more metrics you track, the less likely you are to use them. A compact set of repeatable signals is enough for the first few publishing cycles.
